proposal.summary: A relative path traversal vulnerability in the unknown function of admin-ajax.php in Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1 allows remote attackers to manipulate the upload_name argument to perform path traversal. Public exploit disclosed.
proposal.affected_product: Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1
proposal.cwe_quote: The manipulation of the argument upload_name leads to relative path traversal.

AV.quote: It is possible to launch the attack remotely.

C.quote: The manipulation of the argument upload_name leads to relative path traversal.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review the admin-ajax.php handler for upload_name, add input validation/normalization to prevent '..' or absolute paths, and apply server-side path canonicalization and allow-listing. If exploit is public, prioritize patching and notify users to update or disable the plugin until fixed.

evidence_quotes.quote: Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1
Affected is an unknown function of the file admin-ajax.php.
The manipulation of the argument upload_name leads to relative path traversal.
It is possible to launch the attack remotely.
The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
